comment: Regression for the RR73-as-gridsquare bug: tapping a third station's RR73 (not a CQ, not addressed to us -- the 'tail-ending' feature) must not latch 'RR73' into dxgrid. Mirrors test_fd_touch.json's touch-then-complete shape.

periods.comment: Period 1 (odd): W1ABC closes out a QSO with a THIRD station (K3XYZ), not us -- not a CQ. We touch it to tail-end reply.
Period 2 (even): we send TX1 (our grid) to W1ABC
Period 3 (odd): W1ABC replies with our signal report (never a grid -- standard FT8 only exchanges the initiator's grid)
Period 5 (odd): W1ABC sends RR73 (TX4) -- QSO-closing, same keyword that caused the original bug
Period 6 (even): we send 73 (TX5), QSO complete -- ADIF logs here. dxgrid must be empty, not 'RR73'.
